name: Mihama (Mie, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Mihama town emblem in white: a fan-shaped device crossed by a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Mihama, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1968.

features.role: Mihama town emblem — a fan-shaped device crossed by a stylised character
